body.statement: If \(R=\varnothing\), minimizing \(|J|\) over \(\mathcal J_B(\mathfrak G)\) is exactly the minimum internal \(T\)-to-\(Y\) vertex-cut problem in the fixed bidirected graph and is solvable in polynomial time by vertex splitting and maximum flow.
body.justification: This locates hardness in the ex ante universal completion quantifier rather than a hidden fixed-graph causal obstruction.
body.gap: Known-graph intervention design is generally NP-complete, but the causal-star subclass collapses to ordinary minimum cut.
body.consumer: The planner can dispatch single-completion stars to maximum flow.
